constraints: Keep go.mod, go.work, CI matrices, and container images on one supported Go release.
Check that every dependency's own go directive is compatible with the target toolchain.

steps.instructions: Raise the reported `go` or `toolchain` line from Go 1.22 to a supported release (see the replacement), for example with `go get go@<version> toolchain@<version>`.
steps.title: Raise the Go version

steps.instructions: Update CI setup-go versions, Dockerfile `golang:` images, and other go.mod or go.work files in the repository so they agree.
steps.title: Align other Go version surfaces

verification.purpose: Confirm the active toolchain is the intended release.
Build and test every package on the new release.
Catch problems the newer release reports.

sources.title: Go release history and support policy

rule.summary: The Go release policy supports a major release until two newer major releases exist. Go 1.22 support ended when Go 1.24 was released.
rule.title: Go 1.22 is no longer supported
